captions.detailed: This is a classic architect-style desk lamp in a dark grey and matte black color scheme. It features a heavy, flat cylindrical base, a lower parallel-arm linkage, an upper single-arm segment, and a conical lamp shade at the end. The lower arm rotates on a hinge at the base, the upper arm pivots at the elbow hinge, and the conical shade tilts on a hinge at the tip of the upper arm.
captions.instruction: Generate a classic architect desk lamp with a weighted round base, a lower double-bar arm link, an upper arm link, and a conical shade. Ensure it is fully articulated with revolute joints at the base hinge, elbow hinge, and the shade attachment point.
captions.factory: The code constructs an ArticulatedObject by defining several links and joints. It creates a weighted round base using a flat cylinder. The lower arm is constructed using parallel cylinders or rectangular bars, while the upper arm is built from a single bar. The conical shade is generated using a hollowed cone or lofted circles. Revolute joints are placed at the base, elbow, and shade mounting point to allow realistic mechanical articulation.
